records.title: End-Edge-Cloud Collaborative Computing for Deep Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
records.reason: Borderline as deployment/offload background: it reviews inference partitioning and compression that could transfer to LLMs, but the paper is a general DL survey and presents no LLM-specific deployment evidence or original method.

records.title: Evo-Memory: Benchmarking LLM Agent Test-time Learning with Self-Evolving Memory
records.reason: This is relevant to the persistent-memory lineage, but the source is an evaluation benchmark rather than a proposed efficiency method. It fixes API budgets and measures memory/agent performance, without establishing lower tokens, calls, latency, or compute; retain as borderline background.

records.title: Temporal Attention Unit: Towards Efficient Spatiotemporal Predictive Learning
records.reason: The abstract frames the method around spatial encoders/decoders and temporal prediction for video; no LLM serving improvement is described.

records.title: VmambaIR: Visual State Space Model for Image Restoration
records.reason: Its target is low-level vision restoration and image-quality benchmarks, not LLM inference.

records.title: Advancing Open-source World Models
records.reason: The source’s architecture is a DiT video generator with visual latent/action conditioning. Although it discusses real-time interaction and inference compute, the evaluation and optimizations are video-world generation, not language-model inference.
